note: Items recorded here could NOT be verified from the snapshot. No guessing; listed as gaps only. Excluded data files were not read.

gaps.title: No pinned dependency versions / requirements.txt
gaps.detail: No requirements.txt, environment.yml, or lock file in snapshot. baseline.py needs numpy+pandas; notebook needs numpy+pandas+torch (kernelspec 'mypytorch', python 3.12.9). Exact versions unknown -> full reproducibility of numerical results cannot be guaranteed from snapshot alone.

gaps.title: Training shards absent
gaps.detail: baseline.py (discover_training_pair L84) requires train/train_codeword_x_shard_*.csv + train_noisy_y_shard_*.csv. These are excluded data files, not shipped in snapshot, and were not read. Sampling-dependent BER figures cannot be reproduced.

gaps.title: Test input absent
gaps.detail: baseline.py (open_test_source L239) needs public_test.zip (competition_data/test_noisy_y_public.csv) or --test-csv. Not shipped. Submission reproduction requires the test set.

gaps.title: baseline.zip / public_test.zip archives absent
gaps.detail: CLI defaults reference ROOT/baseline.zip (L31) and ROOT/public_test.zip (L28); neither archive is in the snapshot. Parity matrix is only available unpacked at baseline/baseline/Codes_DB/POLAR_N64_K32.txt.

gaps.title: Pre-computed channel_calibration.npz absent
gaps.detail: Produced at runtime by save_calibration (L228); not shipped. --reuse-calibration requires it to exist first.

gaps.title: Trained model checkpoint absent
gaps.detail: Notebook produces best_participant_residual_decoder.pt at runtime (cell 8) and reloads it (cell 9). No pretrained weights shipped -> notebook inference path requires full training first.

gaps.title: Documented BER figures not independently verifiable
gaps.detail: README reports hard=0.055, OSD-2=0.013, leaderboard=0.01272. These are documented values only; read-only audit forbids execution, so no independent reproduction. Also sampling is stochastic (seed 42 mitigates but channel fit depends on data).

gaps.title: No explicit run scripts / orchestration
gaps.detail: No shell scripts, Makefile, or config files describing the exact run sequence beyond README commands. Exact command history for the reported leaderboard BER (0.01272) is not recorded in snapshot.

gaps.title: Private test labels absent (by design)
gaps.detail: competition_data/test_codeword_x_private.csv is referenced in baseline/baseline/README.md as eval-only private labels; not shipped and not intended for participants.

gaps.title: CUDA availability / device reproducibility
gaps.detail: Notebook selects device = cuda if available else cpu (cell 2). Exact hardware/GPU not specified -> training/inference numerics may vary by device.
